Used roti, tea, pencils, watermelon and square examples.

end.parentNote: Nisha practised naming fractions as equal shares of a whole. Using everyday examples helped them identify one third and notice that equal-sized pieces make a fair share. They mixed up the whole with the parts left or eaten, and this was still present in the final response. At home, draw shapes split into 2, 3 and 4 equal parts and ask, “How many shaded parts out of how many parts altogether?”
